title: What an Animal Owes You
sentences: People describe their pets using language borrowed more or less directly from friendship.
The comparison is entirely understandable, and it is also only partly accurate.
A friendship assumes that either party could walk away without asking permission.
An animal living inside a house has no such option available to it at any point.
This does not make the affection false, but it does change the shape of it.
What the animal offers is steady attention rather than any kind of agreement.
It does not care what I do for a living or how badly the week has actually gone.
Whole days can pass in which I never once have to explain myself to anybody.
That may well be the most restful part of the entire domestic arrangement.
The obligation, when you look at it honestly, runs almost entirely in one direction.
